memoryRule: attention is recorded without geometry; departure selects a least-witnessed fragment in the opposite register, changes its actual position/scale/angle/weight, and leaves an echo elsewhere
interactionRule: pointer proximity or directional focus witnesses without mutation; leaving commits one remote answer; Enter, Space, or the leave control commits deterministically; Delete lifts latest; R or Escape releases
representationRupture: material SVG plate, Canvas cadence score, and route organism -> semantic browser-native text fragments in a double register
compositionRupture: folded plate, three-column score, and connected route -> asymmetrical two-register field separated by a tilted absence
encounterRupture: load a well, tap a cadence, or drag a route -> approach a fragment, then leave so another register answers
temporalRupture: immediate span/cadence/route commitments -> presence without mutation followed by remote departure memory
mediumRupture: inline SVG and p5.js Canvas -> DOM text/CSS geometry with no canvas or SVG renderer
changedRule: A witnessed fragment stays geometrically exact. Only departure makes a least-witnessed fragment in the other register answer through actual position, scale, angle, and weight changes.
visibleConsequence: The blind view is an asymmetrical field of situated text fragments split by a tilted absence. A departure changes a remote fragment and a second echo while the source remains exact; four departures persist and later answers inherit the altered register.
falsifier: Delete if attention moves the source, if the source answers itself, if remote response is cosmetic, if the field reads as a route/grid/interface, if later departures reset, or if exact lifting fails.
deletionCondition: Delete v034 if caption-free viewing cannot distinguish the double register from a decorated word collage, route diagram, or interface, or if the remote answer is not causally produced by departure.
promotion: candidate / held pending local and production browser matrices, independent caption-free perceptual review, and provider revision linkage
